_note: Copied from the shipped TY 2026-27 timeline for W-146's synthetic pack (W-238e); not law, never shipped. Original note: The rules an employer's contribution to a recognised provident fund feeds (W-238e). By its condition on employer.fund: PERQ-RPF-CONTRIBUTION charges the contribution beyond its share of salary (1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.6(a)), TY 2025-26 only, so a later year's pack drops it. PERQ-EMPLOYER-CONTRIBUTION adds up every employer contribution to a recognised provident fund, the notified pension scheme and an approved superannuation fund and charges the excess over its limit (S2 s.17(1)(h); 1961 s.17(2)(vii); D-126); PERQ-EMPLOYER-ACCRETION charges the accretion on that excess (S2 s.17(1)(i); 1961 s.17(2)(viia); D-127). Neither reads employer.fund in a condition: EmployerContributionNode reaches both with every contribution (W-238e).
